description.content:
Creates a new payment page for a paypoint.
Note: this operation doesn't create a new paypoint, just a payment page for an existing paypoint. Paypoints are created by the Payabli team when a boarding application is approved.

header.description: _Optional but recommended_ A unique ID that you can include to prevent duplicating objects or transactions in the case that a request is sent more than once. This key isn't generated in Payabli, you must generate it yourself. This key persists for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, you can reuse the key if needed.
